_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits inside Disbelief band with leg flat and no confirmed squeeze or distribution break; base rate favors coil persistence.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Disbelief; narrative descriptive on flows only, no opposing directional call
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed holds 55-68, 30d momentum stays near 50, funding remains roughly flat
next_move.invalidated_if: 30d momentum lifts through ~70 with funding heat (up into Hope) or fear_greed breaks under ~50 on sustained exchange inflows (down into Complacency)
